title: A bright little Dubai break
description: Mix city sights, open evenings, and time to explore. The itinerary and price are tailored to your travel dates.
fullDescription: A flexible Dubai city break with room for sightseeing and downtime. Ask for a quote based on your dates, preferred hotel, transfers, and the experiences you would like included.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Dubai
itinerary.text: Arrive and check in at the hotel selected for your confirmed quote.

itinerary.title: Discover the city
itinerary.text: Explore city highlights and choose experiences that match your interests.

itinerary.title: A day to make your own
itinerary.text: Keep time open for shopping, a local experience, or a slower day.

itinerary.title: Departure day
itinerary.text: Check out and continue to the airport according to your confirmed transfer plan.
